blockers: TorchCodec 0.8.0 cannot load against Torch 2.9.1+cu128. TorchCodec itself now names the cause: "Could not load libtorchcodec ... The PyTorch version (2.9.1+cu128) is not compatible with this version of TorchCodec." Three earlier suspicions were eliminated first: the wheel variant (the CPU build was replaced by the CUDA-matched build of the same version), the wheel-provenance comparison (a local version is served percent-encoded and could never match), and the test environment (media decode was being validated on a CPU-only container, which is not a runtime MOSS serves in; it now runs on a GPU). The resolution is the runtime upgrade upstream already requires - MOSS-Music's own pyproject pins TorchCodec 0.9.* - and that is Wave Q's Q-01, not a wheel change.
